description.narrative: The project will support strategic development of institutional capacity and analytic tools to improve Ministry of Finances systems, including strengthening climate change governance mechanisms, promoting the use of data for evidence-based decision making, and improving business climate and competitiveness, strengthening market institutions.

title.narrative: Climate change informed macro, financial or fiscal processes

comment.narrative:
This indicator will monitor the adoption of climate change related inputs into relevant economic, financial and fiscal processes related to budgeting, public investment management, macro and financial reporting.
As of June 2025, the SIRFE system has been adopted by 99 per cent of units in the administration, effectively reducing the need for paper based receipts. This is an achievement that takes into consideration the impact of paper receipts on climate.
As of January 2026, the Budget unit has incorporated a mandate, and guidance, for all units during the implementation of the budget starting in 2026 to document climate actions and climate impact of their activities. In addition, Uruguay created a fund to pay for projects that help the country meet environmental goals linked to its sustainable financing programs (Fondo para el Clima y la Naturaleza de Uruguay - Ley de Presupuesto 20.446).

This indicator will measure the number of newly designed and deployed online services by MEF.
As of January 2026, 33 new online services have been launched.
